programme_name_history: No former programme name was identified in the current official sources.
admission_type: Open access, subject to evaluation of curricular requirements and the candidate's personal preparation by the Admissions Committee.
academic_requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or a recognized suitable equivalent and demonstrate adequate preparation in engineering fundamentals, biomedical engineering, and medicine. The current programme-specific requirements are: at least 35 ECTS in basic Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Statistics subjects, including at least 15 ECTS in MATH-03/A; at least 20 ECTS in core Industrial Engineering (L-9) subjects; at least 10 ECTS in LM-21 Bioengineering (IBIO-01/A); and at least 5 ECTS in LM-21 Medical Disciplines. Credits may be counted only once. The Admissions Committee verifies both curricular compliance and personal preparation. These current requirements supersede the older 39+18+6+6+6+6 CFU structure still displayed on the DreamApply record.

curricular_requirements_cfu.basic_subjects: At least 35 ECTS in the listed Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Statistics SSDs, including at least 15 ECTS in MATH-03/A
curricular_requirements_cfu.industrial_engineering: At least 20 ECTS in the listed core Industrial Engineering (L-9) SSDs
curricular_requirements_cfu.bioengineering: At least 10 ECTS in LM-21 Bioengineering, SSD IBIO-01/A
curricular_requirements_cfu.medical_disciplines: At least 5 ECTS in the listed LM-21 Medical Disciplines SSDs
curricular_requirements_cfu.counting_rule: Each ECTS credit can be counted only once
curricular_requirements_cfu.legacy_record_note: The official DreamApply course record still states an older structure: 39 basic CFU (21 Mathematics/Computer Science/Statistics, including 15 MAT/05), 18 Physics/Chemistry, and 6 each in Mechanics, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering and Biology. The current programme admission page is treated as authoritative.

entry_exam_or_test: No competitive entrance examination is published. The Admissions Committee evaluates the academic record, curricular requirements and personal preparation; the central 2026/27 calendar describes assessment windows as interview/test periods.
interview_required: An assessment of personal preparation is required, but the current programme page does not state that every applicant must attend an interview [uncertain].
selection_scoring: No numerical ranking rubric or pass threshold is published. Eligibility depends on the programme-specific ECTS/SSD requirements and the Admissions Committee's assessment of personal preparation.
degree_completion_deadline: For standard 2026/27 pre-enrolment, an applicant may be conditionally pre-enrolled with no more than three examinations totaling no more than 24 ECTS outstanding, in addition to the final examination, and must graduate by the March/April 2027 extraordinary session. For the international pre-evaluation route, the 2026 checklist states that free-access applicants awaiting graduation had to expect completion by 2026-06-30.
application_channel: Applicants with foreign qualifications use the official UniBG online pre-evaluation/DreamApply route. The 2026/27 preliminary evaluation is strongly recommended for non-EU applicants to free-access programmes but is not compulsory; later standard pre-enrolment is available through UniBG student services with the programme fee. Visa-seeking non-EU applicants must also follow Universitaly and consular procedures.
language_requirements: English proficiency at CEFR B2 or equivalent is required. The programme admission page says verification methods and possible certification exemptions are specified in the admission procedures. The official international checklist accepts listed B2 certificates or an eligible medium-of-instruction certificate; unofficial certificates and self-declarations are not accepted.
accepted_english_certificates: TOEFL iBT: 72-94 in the current 2026 checklist (the programme's DreamApply record still shows 79-95)
Cambridge FCE: grades B or C
Pearson Test of English General: Level 3
TIE: minimum B2 in both oral and written tests
ESB ESOL International: minimum Pass with Merit
language_waiver_conditions: A medium-of-instruction certificate issued by the registrar or international office is accepted when the completed degree was taught entirely in English. The DreamApply record also states that native English-speaking applicants are exempt. Unofficial certificates and self-declarations are not accepted.
application_deadline_non_eu: The standard free-access deadlines also remain available because UniBG states pre-evaluation is not compulsory; applicants must separately meet visa/Universitaly timing [uncertain]

application_call_round.route: International online pre-evaluation first call - free-access master's programmes
International online pre-evaluation second call - free- and limited-access master's programmes

results_notification_date: International pre-evaluation results were scheduled by 2026-03-31 for the first call and by 2026-04-30 for the second call. Standard open-access rounds publish assessment and enrolment windows rather than a ranked-results date.
required_documents: Colour digital copy of the original bachelor's degree, translated into English or Italian; if pending under the free-access pre-evaluation route, an official expected-graduation certificate
Official academic transcript for the last three/four years translated into English or Italian, or Diploma Supplement
Accepted English B2 certificate or qualifying medium-of-instruction certificate
Colour copy of a valid passport
Major Area Form duly completed; however, the current central page does not visibly provide a Medical Engineering-specific form [uncertain]
At least one academic reference according to the programme's DreamApply record
references_required: At least 1 reference according to the official Medical Engineering DreamApply record; the current central checklist describes a reference letter as recommended rather than one of its five compulsory documents, creating a source inconsistency [uncertain].
course_descriptions_required: The central pre-evaluation route requires a completed Major Area Form, but its current list of downloadable programme forms does not visibly include Medical Engineering. Whether a separate Medical Engineering course-description form is required should be confirmed [uncertain].
application_fee: EUR 30 for the 2026/27 international online pre-evaluation route.
pre_enrolment_fee: EUR 52 for each selected master's programme, with up to two programme choices.
enrolment_deposit: EUR 156 one-time, non-refundable enrolment fee payable on arrival in Italy, according to the official programme application record.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://en.unibg.it/study/enrollment/costs/taxes-and-benefits — official fees and benefits page. The official programme application record lists a first tuition instalment of EUR 0-400 and a second instalment of EUR 0-1,700 depending on family income.
tuition_income_linked: Yes. UniBG's 2026/27 comprehensive contribution is income/ISEEU-linked, and the programme record states that both tuition instalments depend on family income.

source_quotes.quote: Admission to the Master's Degree is subject to an evaluation process based on curricular requirements (academic career) and assessment of the candidate's personal preparation.
Have earned at least 35 ECTS credits in basic subjects, including Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Statistics.
Demonstrate English language proficiency at least at B2 level.
Pre-registration is permitted for applicants who, by the date of official enrollment, have no more than three exams left to complete and a maximum of 24 ECTS credits outstanding.
Study location Italy, Dalmine; Type Master degree, full-time; Study language English.
From November 24th 2025 to January 15th 2026: prospective students can apply.

uncertainty_notes: Current 2026/27 central deadlines and the current Medical Engineering admission page were prioritized. A material conflict exists: the current programme page uses the reformed SSD codes and a 35+20+10+5 ECTS structure, while the older DreamApply record still displays a 39+18+6+6+6+6 structure. The current programme page is treated as authoritative. The interview format/language, exact non-EU visa-safe final deadline, reference status, and programme-specific Major Area Form requirement are not fully resolved by the official pages.
source_access_status: Official UNIBG sources only. The programme, admission, central deadlines, international pre-evaluation, fees, and DreamApply pages were directly accessed through indexed official content. DreamApply application-action pages were not accessible without an application session.
